privacy: fixture class metrics only; no private source IDs, filenames or digests
interpretation: All tested fixtures contain substantial vector drawing content.
Vector path extraction is usable for clean geometry guides and regression evidence.
Reconstructed vector SVG is a subset of the rendered PDF appearance and must not be treated as a complete source snapshot.
Full source snapshot preservation requires a second overlay/evidence path for annotations, special PDF graphics and other non-reconstructed content.
Raw pixel/edge mismatch is renderer-sensitive and is not itself a geometry-failure threshold.
Multiply composition of a full source snapshot over a neutral presentation underlay preserved rendered source edges far better than reconstructing vector paths alone in these fixtures.
This supports automating the traditional CAD/PDF Multiply finishing step as a preservation fallback, while keeping vector overlays for clean/styleable geometry lines.

resulting_contract.source_snapshot_overlay: full-page source render with white-to-alpha treatment when complete visual preservation is required
resulting_contract.validation: geometry/object checks dominate; edge checks are supporting evidence
resulting_contract.source_snapshot_composition: MULTIPLY preferred for full rendered-source preservation; white source remains transparent in effect without thresholding.
